text:
marta_cs: Morning quick check for DockLine private deploy — audit export shows objects landing in S3 but our SIEM has no events. Suspect KMS grant, egress to collector, or sampling. @liu_customer can you paste the forwarder error logs?

liu_customer: Collector acct 7766554433. Agent logs show "DecryptionFailure: AccessDenied" and then "0 events forwarded". No obvious network errors.

pavel_infra: First things: confirm KMS key policy includes the forwarder role and allows kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey*. Also validate either VPC egress to kms endpoint or an interface endpoint exists.

sasha_sre: Also check assume-role trust policy for the forwarder if cross-account; external-id mismatches are common. Quick assume-role test: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn ... --external-id ... && aws sts get-caller-identity`.

marta_cs: Plan: 1) @liu_customer confirm KMS key ARN + sampling setting, 2) @pavel_infra share minimal policy snippet, 3) @sasha_sre post assume-role check snippet, 4) I'll open a ticket and mark week0 blocker if unresolved in 24h.

opsbot: New ticket created: CS-9001 — "DockLine: SIEM ingestion missing (KMS/egress/sampling)" https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-9001

liu_customer: KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:112211221122:key/dd11-ee22. Sampling was 0 (oversight), bumped to 2% while we triage. Updating key policy now.

pavel_infra: Minimal KMS policy we use: Principal arn:aws:iam::7766554433:role/splunk-forwarder Actions kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey*. Scope the Resource to the key ARN, avoid wildcards.

liu_customer: Policy updated and replayed backlog — events started appearing in SIEM. CloudTrail shows no KMS Deny entries. Closing immediate blocker; monitoring for 48h.

marta_cs: Thanks team. Week0 health -> yellow, renewal risk low. Follow-up validation in 2 weeks and add runbook note: set default sampling >=5% for first 72h on private deploys to surface issues early.
